scope: Matched frozen Wide GEMM cases; final BF16 output store included; not full Decode device validation

assumptions: Fast-tier internal timing surrogate, not calibrated Mono3D
128TF peak MAC service, operand/register reuse ideal within a MAC block
Aggregate private-SRAM ports are assumed, explicitly arbitrated each tick
Two virtual networks and router multicast common to all partitions
Vector packet read/add/write are serial, transport and MAC may overlap
Input starts canonically sharded in private SRAM; output same canonical shards
No functional FP16 numerical inference claim, no thermal feedback

records.output_ownership: canonical equal output shards, as H2
records.abstraction_difference: H3:up-to32KiB memory-service abstraction,256B packets,decoupled_flight=True,serialized SRAM/MAC phases; H2:actual1024B requests,32B flits,overlapping MAC ports
records.scope: Qualification experiment; no fitting, no claim that finite staging granularity is identical
